title: Account Administration
description: Manage accounts, roles, driver links and passwords.

driverLink.roleNoLink: This account has the Driver role but is not linked to a driver.
driverLink.linkNoRole: Linked to a driver but does not have the Driver role.

create.title: Create account
create.tempInfo: The user will get an email with a login link and a temporary password (12345678). They must change it on first sign-in.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.for: Set a new temporary password for {name} ({email}).
reset.hint: Minimum 8 characters. The user must change it on next sign-in.

suspend.title: Suspend account?
suspend.body: Suspend {name}? They will be signed out and unable to sign in until reactivated. This is reversible.

reactivate.title: Reactivate account?
reactivate.body: Reactivate {name}? They will be able to sign in again.

remove.title: Remove account?
remove.permanent: This is permanent and cannot be undone.
remove.driverKept: The linked driver in the roster is NOT deleted.
remove.historyKept: Standings, results and stats are unaffected.
remove.caseRefs: Existing steward cases keep this account's id as a reference.
remove.tip: Tip: use Suspend to disable an account reversibly instead.

success.created: Account created. The user must change their password on first sign-in.
success.reset: Password reset. The user must set a new password on next sign-in.

errors.email-taken: An account with that email already exists.
errors.own-admin: You cannot remove your own admin role.
errors.last-admin: This is the last admin — the admin role can't be removed and the account can't be suspended or removed.
errors.cannot-remove-self: You cannot remove your own account.
errors.cannot-suspend-self: You cannot suspend your own account.
errors.password-short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
